title: Graduate Engineer - Urban Development
content_text: Graduate Engineer. Location Sunshine Coast, QLD. Full time. 1 position. Job no 9ET7B. Opportunities for Civil Engineering Graduates to join the Urban Development team in the Sunshine Coast office. The Calibre Graduate Program is a two-year integrated experience combining on-the-job learning, professional and technical training, mentoring and development across sectors. Calibre is part of Calibre Group alongside Diona and Sevengen. Requirements: recently graduated with relevant tertiary qualifications in Civil Engineering and 0-1 years of experience; keen interest in Calibre; excellent written and verbal communication; commitment, willingness to learn, deadline-driven environment. All applications should include a resume and covering letter as well as copies of academic transcripts; applications without these will not be considered. apply_instructions: Apply on LiveHire with resume, covering letter and academic transcripts.
